subject.title: fix(agents): retry same profile before timeout auth rotation

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally make the first ordinary assistant timeout retry the same model/profile before auth-profile rotation or model fallback?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive fallback/auth-provider policy change: the implementation is focused, but automation cannot decide whether delaying fallback by one timeout is the desired default for existing users.

options.title: Accept Bounded Retry
options.body: Merge the current approach after exact-head checks pass, accepting one extra same-profile timeout as the default before rotation or fallback.

options.title: Keep Immediate Failover
options.body: Reject or revise the PR so ordinary assistant timeouts keep spending the existing rotation/fallback lane immediately.

options.title: Request Narrower Policy
options.body: Ask for a different product shape, such as limiting the retry to a narrower failure class, before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Retry
recommendation.body: Merge the current approach after exact-head checks pass, accepting one extra same-profile timeout as the default before rotation or fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The current main history routes the extracted failover/attempt modules through Vincent Koc's recent refactor, and the decision is about that owner boundary rather than a contributor-only fix.
